boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Assumption University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Worcester food stops with late service documented on current official business pages. Confirm hours before leaving because schedules can change.

cards.title: Ready Set Pizza After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Pizza and subs on West Boylston Street
cards.notes: Check the official site before leaving, then use the posted West Boylston Street address for a late pizza or sub pickup.
cards.short_summary: A north Worcester pizza counter documenting service into the early morning every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Ready Set Pizza’s official site lists its address as 292 West Boylston Street and its daily hours as 11:00 a.m. to 2:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Sunday hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:30 a.m.; verify current service before traveling.

cards.title: Fastway Pizza at 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Seven-night service on West Boylston Street
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s hours page to confirm the 1 a.m. closing, and call ahead when placing a late pickup order.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day pizza, pasta, calzone, salad, and sub stop with a clearly posted late close.
cards.evidence_claim: Fastway Pizza’s official hours page lists 84 West Boylston Street and service from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The official hours page lists 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Monday through Sunday; confirm before departure.

cards.title: Papa Flame’s 2:30 A.M. Window
cards.subtitle: Pizza, wings, salads, and ice cream on Stafford Street
cards.notes: Review the menu online, confirm the daily closing time, and navigate to the Stafford Street storefront for pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Stafford Street option whose own website documents the same early-morning closing time all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Flame Pizza’s official website lists its location at 153 Stafford Street and states that it is open daily from 11:00 a.m. to 2:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The business website states “Open Daily” from 11:00 a.m.–2:30 a.m.; recheck before making the run.

cards.title: Golden Pizza’s Late Counter
cards.subtitle: An extensive takeout menu on Lincoln Street
cards.notes: Browse the large online menu first, verify that late service is operating, and order for pickup at the Lincoln Street shop.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln Street kitchen with pizza, grinders, bowls, salads, wraps, and a posted 2 a.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Pizza’s official website identifies the restaurant at 31 New Lincoln Street and posts daily hours from 10:30 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official website posts daily hours of 10:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; confirm the schedule before ordering.

cards.title: Freshway’s Six Late Nights
cards.subtitle: Pizza and subs in Worcester’s Water Street area
cards.notes: Plan this run for Tuesday through Sunday, check the official schedule, and call the restaurant if pickup timing is tight.
cards.short_summary: A Water Street takeout stop documenting six weekly nights of service until 2:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshway Pizza’s official hours page lists 96 Water Street and hours of noon to 2:30 a.m. Tuesday through Sunday, with Monday closed.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are noon–2:30 a.m. Tuesday–Sunday; the restaurant is closed Monday. Verify before traveling.

cards.title: J&J Pizza Express Past 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Brazilian and American choices at Rice Square
cards.notes: Use the weekly schedule to distinguish the 1 a.m. and 2:30 a.m. nights, then call ahead for late pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Rice Square restaurant with pizza, pasta, sandwiches, seafood, and later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: J&J Pizza Express’s official hours page lists 3 Rice Square, 1:00 a.m. closing Sunday through Thursday, and 2:30 a.m. closing Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official closing is 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before departure.

cards.entity_name: Fresh Way Pizza on Main Street
cards.title: Fresh Way on Main Until 2
cards.subtitle: A separate late-night storefront in southwest Worcester
cards.notes: Make sure your order is routed to the Main Street location, review its menu online, and verify the 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza shop with an official ordering page showing service through 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresh Way Pizza’s official location and ordering site lists the restaurant at 1406 Main Street and displays operating hours of 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant page displays 10:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; verify the day’s schedule before ordering.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Grafton Street Stop
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock drive-through and dine-in service
cards.notes: Check the live location page before setting out and use this specific Grafton Street address to avoid mixing up branches.
cards.short_summary: A named Worcester chain location whose official page currently documents 24-hour access every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 801 Grafton Street lists both drive-through and dine-in hours as open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 801 Grafton Street, Worcester
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists drive-through service as open 24 hours daily and shows 24-hour dine-in; recheck before visiting.

cards.title: Park Avenue’s 3 A.M. Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Weekend drive-through service near the Clark University area
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the late window, because the posted dine-in schedule closes earlier than vehicle service.
cards.short_summary: A Park Avenue branch with official drive-through hours extending later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 418 Park Avenue lists drive-through service until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 418 Park Avenue, Worcester
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Verify first.

cards.title: Worcester Pizza Factory After Midnight
cards.subtitle: A Maywood Street option on late-week nights
cards.notes: Schedule this stop for Thursday through Saturday, consult the current menu, and call ahead before a post-midnight pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Maywood Street pizza shop documenting a 2 a.m. closing on three nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Worcester Pizza Factory’s official menu lists 75 Maywood Street and hours until 2:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday, with a 10:00 p.m. close Monday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: The official menu lists 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday and 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday–Wednesday; verify first.
